read_scope: Sections 2.1 metrics, 4, 5 and 6. No complete paper or appendix replication.
findings: Probability can miss components with negative effects when the relevant probability is already small. The paper motivates logit difference and discusses KL as a distribution metric.
Joint multi-layer patch effects differ from adding separate single-layer effects. The authors describe their joint-window result as a joint effect, not evidence for one layer.
Which tokens are corrupted changes what information an intervention traces.
application: Keep all signed finite margins and KL. Do not infer individual neuron meanings or formal synergy from the broad-state control. N22 stage/site results remain bounded by the chosen prompts, donors and positions. Actual donor states do not prove that every joint internal combination is on distribution.
